primary_candidate: step25, selected using validation before test
test_selection: one last eligible supervised assistant boundary per each of 247 test trajectories; complete original history, input<=64512
cache_policy: radix disabled for every request; same independent compile cache copied from old run, warm-up32tokens per variant; startup excluded
correctness: 10 fixed diagnostics including 2 old mismatch prompts and 8 held-out validation prefixes; target A/A must be stable; common-prefix logprob probes for mismatches
known_parity_issue: Prior AR vs DSPARK FP4 output mismatch remains unresolved. No lossless claim unless diagnostics AND 247 test outputs all match. Finite, pre-declared matrix measures discrepancy; no tuning or automatic reruns on test.
scope: complete-prefix prompt replay with fixed output length, not full trajectories or closed-loop SWE solve rate; long trajectories represented by earlier prefix, never called full long-context coverage
failure_policy: worker/API errors stop with evidence and no resubmission; inspect full static call chain before changing and re-validating
resource_policy: user-requested migration: one8H100 node040 pod, fixed-digest archive imported by init into assigned node containerd; exact image only, no pruning; regular serving container has no host runtime mount. CPU exports reused from r2.
